text.p: Swiss shares closed higher on the day but below midday highs when the market temporarily overcame the 3,700 point psychological barrier on the blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI).
The blue-chip SMI rose 36.5 points, or one percent, to 3,697.7 and the all-share Swiss Performance Index added 21.38 points, or 0.91 percent, to close at 2,370.77.
Dealers said the U.S. Federal Reserve's Tuesday decision to leave interest rates unchanged calmed the market.
"People were relieved that the issue has disappeared for awhile", one trader said. Firming government bond futures also improved the mood, he added.
Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz gained around 1.4 percent each while heavily-traded Roche certificates rose 75 francs to 9,155.
Union Bank of Switzerland's (UBS) bearer shares were up six francs to 1,190.
BK Vision, which holds nearly a 10 percent stake in UBS, said it would appeal a Zurich court ruling which upheld the bank's plans to convert to a single share structure.
